# FairCredit AI: Synthetic Data for Bias-Free Financial Inclusion ![FairCredit AI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FairCredit-AI-blue) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.11%2B-green) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow) ![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-Ready-blue) ![Nix](https://img.shields.io/badge/Nix-Enabled-orange) ## 🎯 Overview FairCredit AI is an innovative platform that addresses algorithmic bias in credit assessment systems using generative AI. By creating synthetic financial datasets that preserve legitimate risk patterns while eliminating discriminatory biases, we enable financial institutions to build accurate, compliant, and equitable credit models. **Key Problem**: Traditional credit scoring systems systematically exclude marginalized populations through biases embedded in historical data, affecting 1.4+ billion unbanked adults globally. **Our Solution**: Generate fair synthetic training data using constrained Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to prevent bias at the source rather than attempting post-hoc corrections. ## ✨ Features - **🔍 Bias Detection**: Comprehensive analysis of credit data for discriminatory patterns - **🔄 Synthetic Data Generation**: AI-powered creation of balanced, representative datasets - **✅ Validation Framework**: Rigorous testing of data quality and model utility - **🌍 Global Context**: Adaptable across markets and financial systems - **🔒 Privacy-First**: Differential privacy and synthetic data protection - **📊 Interactive Demo**: Streamlit-based visualization and experimentation platform ## 🚀 Quick Start ### Prerequisites - **Option 1**: Docker & Docker Compose - **Option 2**: Nix package manager - **Option 3**: Python 3.11+ with pip ### Using Docker (Recommended) ```bash # Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/your-username/faircredit-ai cd faircredit-ai # Start all services docker-compose up # Or start specific services docker-compose up api # FastAPI backend docker-compose up demo # Streamlit frontend docker-compose up notebooks # Jupyter notebooks ``` ### Using Nix ```bash # Enter development environment nix develop # Run services faircredit-api # Start API server faircredit-demo # Launch Streamlit demo faircredit-notebook # Start Jupyter notebooks # Run tests pytest tests/ ``` ### Using Python Directly ```bash # Install dependencies pip install -r requirements.txt # Set up Python path export PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src:$PYTHONPATH # Run API server uvicorn src.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 # Run Streamlit demo (in another terminal) cd frontend streamlit run streamlit_app.py ``` ## 📍 Access Points After starting the services, access them at: - **API Server**: http://localhost:8000 - **API Documentation**: http://localhost:8000/docs - **Streamlit Demo**: http://localhost:8501 - **Jupyter Notebooks**: http://localhost:8888 ## 🛠️ Technology Stack ### Backend & AI - **Python 3.11+** - Core programming language - **FastAPI** - Modern, fast web framework for APIs - **PyTorch** - Deep learning framework - **CTGAN** - Conditional Tabular GAN for synthetic data - **AI Fairness 360** - Bias detection and mitigation - **Scikit-learn** - Machine learning utilities ### Frontend & Visualization - **Streamlit** - Interactive web application framework - **Plotly** - Interactive visualizations - **Matplotlib/Seaborn** - Statistical visualizations ### Deployment & Infrastructure - **Docker** - Containerization - **Docker Compose** - Multi-container orchestration - **Nix** - Reproducible development environments - **Uvicorn** - ASGI server ### Testing & Development - **pytest** - Testing framework - **Jupyter** - Interactive notebooks - **Black** - Code formatting - **Pylint** - Code linting ## 📖 Usage Examples ### 1. Bias Detection ```python from src.core.bias_detector import BiasDetector import pandas as pd # Load your credit data data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_data.csv') # Analyze for biases detector = BiasDetector() results = detector.analyze_dataset(data) print(results['bias_metrics']) ``` ### 2. Synthetic Data Generation ```python from src.core.data_generator import FairDataGenerator # Generate fair synthetic data generator = FairDataGenerator() generator.train_model(original_data) synthetic_data = generator.generate_fair_data( num_samples=1000, protected_attributes=['gender', 'location'] ) ``` ### 3. API Usage ```bash # Analyze bias via API curl -X POST "http://localhost:8000/api/v1/analyze-bias" \ -F "file=@data/credit_data.csv" # Generate synthetic data curl -X POST "http://localhost:8000/api/v1/generate-data" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"num_samples": 1000, "protected_attributes": ["gender", "location"]}' ``` ## 🧪 Testing Run the test suite to ensure everything works correctly: ```bash # Using pytest directly pytest tests/ # Using Nix nix run .#test # With coverage report pytest --cov=src tests/ ``` ## 🤝 Contributing We welcome contributions! Please see our [Contributing Guidelines](docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) for details. 1. Fork the repository 2. Create a feature branch (`git checkout -b feature/amazing-feature`) 3. Commit your changes (`git commit -m 'Add amazing feature'`) 4. Push to the branch (`git push origin feature/amazing-feature`) 5. Open a Pull Request ## 📄 License This project is licensed under the MIT License - see the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details. ## 🙏 Acknowledgments - **Central Bank of Kenya** for inspiration on ethical AI in financial services - **AI Fairness 360** team for bias detection tools - **SDV** team for synthetic data generation libraries - The open-source community for invaluable tools and libraries ## 📞 Support & Contact - **Developer**: Timothy Nduati - **Email**: timothynn08@gmail.com - **GitHub**: [@timothynn](https://github.com/timothynn) ## 🔮 Roadmap - [ ] Multi-modal data support (text, transaction histories) - [ ] Real-time bias monitoring - [ ] Expanded regulatory compliance frameworks - [ ] Cloud-native deployment templates - [ ] Federated learning capabilities ---
**Built with ❤️ for a more equitable financial future** *Eliminating bias, one algorithm at a time*
